items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially inactive vs Colts in London.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered late in practice week.
items.implication: Elevates other Commanders pass-catchers; Deebo Samuel and others see expanded roles.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for WAS WRs/TEs without McLaurin.

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs Eagles.
items.why: Hip/groin issue resolved enough for no snap restriction.
items.implication: Full Puka usage boosts Rams offense and his fantasy ceiling vs depleted Eagles secondary.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share expected on return.

items.text: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (ankle) expected to play today despite questionable tag.
49ers WR Mike Evans (ribs) practiced late week, said he’ll do his best; team optimistic though Kittle notes fractured ribs suck. GTD.
items.implication: If out, Kittle/CMC/Purdy/Deebo boost; monitor warmups.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (quad) unlikely to play vs Lions despite questionable.
items.implication: Boosts other CAR WRs like Tetairoa McMillan.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) is likely to play today; not as serious as recent rib injury.
items.why: Battled foot all week (LP-DNP-LP) but source confirms likely.
items.implication: Startable if active; monitors inactives closely.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) expected to play; was questionable after limited week.
items.why: Limited practices but source says expected.
items.implication: Locks in as WR1 for BAL; reduces backup upside.

items.text: Seahawks place rookie RB Jadarian Price on IR (chest); signed Velus Jones Jr. from PS.
items.implication: Kenneth Walker and others handle full load; Velus as depth.

items.text: Colts WR Keenan Allen (groin) downgraded to OUT vs Commanders; Westbrook-Ikhine elevated.
items.why: Groin injury; did not practice Friday.
items.implication: Josh Downs becomes clear WR1; more targets to Warren/TE and others.

items.text: Puka Nacua great to have back (possible snap limits TBD); Nico Collins excellent return spot vs Cowboys (top DvP inflating WR scoring 7.3%, Texans high implied total).
items.implication: Strong starts for both; monitor Nacua snaps (later confirmed no limit).

items.text: Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun vs Rams; Jordan Addison home vs weak secondary with Jefferson out is the moment truthers waited for.
items.implication: Addison smash spot; fade Eagles pass game somewhat.
items.opportunity: Addison target spike; reverse for Eagles skill if any IN.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries dump: IN Nacua/Collins/Swift/Irving/Pollard; Q McConkey/Flowers/McLaurin/Evans/Allen/Spears; OUT Jefferson/Hall/Smith/Goedert/Price/Achane/Daniels/Williams et al.
items.why: Comprehensive pre-Sunday status list aligning with beat reports.
items.implication: Clear start/sit and beneficiary map for Week 4.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUTs: Addison (JJ), Eagles backups (Smith/Goedert), etc.

items.text: Parlay lean: Garrett Wilson (no AD Mitchell) as underdog, Michael Wilson 7+ targets vs NYG, Addison without Jefferson vs MIA.
items.implication: Strong DFS/season-long lean on these WRs.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) went LP-DNP-LP; already dealt with cracked rib this season.
items.implication: Risky if active; later Rap expected to play mitigates.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ yards to RB every game.
LOVE Jeremiyah Love @ NYG: 26 touches last week (RB5 util), double-digit target share every game; NYG allows 5.1 YPC.
LOVE Drake London (Penix 35%+ TS career), Garrett Wilson (no Mitchell 36% TS), Josh Downs (31% TS/RZ, WAS worst vs WR), George Kittle (rising share, Evans GTD).
items.implication: Strong WR/TE plays; Kittle upside if Evans limited.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (low util/target/route, SEA stout vs RB), Justin Herbert (pressure/SEA D/low total), Kyle Pitts (low TS w/ Penix), Emeka Egbuka (new QB/low RZ/low total), Xavier Worthy (shrinking share vs Rice).
